chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Hasan, from Zur'ah, from Sama'ah, who said:

Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام said to me: Pray on the night of the twenty-first and the night of the twenty-third of Ramadan, in each one of them, if you have the strength for that, one hundred rak'ahs, apart from the thirteen rak'ahs.

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu 'Abdillah, the Imam speaking in the narration
key_terms.الثَّلَاثَ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً: the thirteen rak'ahs counted separately from the one hundred
key_terms.لَيْلَةِ إِحْدَى وَعِشْرِينَ: the night of the twenty-first of Ramadan
key_terms.لَيْلَةِ ثَلَاثٍ وَعِشْرِينَ: the night of the twenty-third of Ramadan

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام recommend praying on the 21st and 23rd nights of Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs performing extra salat (prayer) on the nights of the twenty-first and twenty-third of Ramadan. It indicates a recommended devotional practice of one hundred rak'ahs on each of those nights, in addition to the thirteen rak'ahs.
